ads.headline: Lead gen intent collapsing—service businesses must pivot to brand awareness now
actions: Switch 30% of $25 daily budget to brand awareness campaigns targeting service area zip codes
Create short educational video ads (plumbing tips, gutter cleaning warnings) to build trust before leads ask
Test seasonal demand keywords in Campaign Names to track which services trending in your regions
ads.source: Google Trends zero interest in 'lead generation' + r/FacebookAds low ad cost discussions indicate market saturation shift

creative.headline: Unable to provide strategic recommendations — insufficient performance data
actions: The Google Trends data shows zero volume across all tracked keywords this week, making trend analysis impossible
No real engagement metrics provided (views, likes, shares, DMs, or follower growth) to identify what's actually working vs. failing
Cannot recommend a video idea without knowing which of his recent posts resonated (talking head vs. screen records vs. reels format, specific ad angles, hook styles)
creative.source: Provided data is incomplete — need actual Instagram Insights metrics: top 5 posts by engagement this week, comment themes, DM inquiry volume, and audience growth rate to give actionable strategy

critic.headline: Most failing ads this week have no clear offer — just a service name
actions: Open your current ad — does it have a specific outcome and deadline, or just your service name?
If your CTA is 'Learn More' or 'Contact Us' — change it to 'Get a Free Quote' or similar action
Check your click-to-lead rate: if under 15%, your offer is the problem, not the audience

competitors.headline: No one is teaching service businesses HOW to respond to leads from ads
actions: Uncovered angle: competitors teach how to get leads but never what to say when the lead comes in — film 'exact script I tell my clients to use when someone fills in the form'
Pain point from this week: 'I got leads from my ads but none of them booked' — hook: 'You got leads but nobody booked. Here is exactly why and how to fix it in one message'
Top accounts posting 3-4x per week minimum with one Reel hitting 10k+ views acting as top of funnel — post volume is the differentiator right now
